description: This file defines utility functions for class loading, reflection, and interface retrieval within the Apache Spark project, encapsulated in the SparkClassUtils trait and object.

classes.name: SparkClassUtils
classes.description: A trait providing class loading, reflection, and interface retrieval utilities for Spark.

methods.name: getSparkClassLoader
methods.description: Returns the class loader of the current class.

methods.name: getContextOrSparkClassLoader
methods.description: Returns the current thread's context class loader or the Spark class loader if null.

methods.name: classForName
methods.description: Loads a class by name with options for initialization and class loader choice.

methods.name: classIsLoadable
methods.description: Checks if a class can be loaded without initializing.

methods.name: classIsLoadableAndAssignableFrom
methods.description: Checks if a class is loadable and assignable from a target class.

methods.name: getFormattedClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of an object without dollar signs.

methods.name: getSimpleName
methods.description: Safely retrieves the simple name of a class, handling internal errors.

methods.name: stripPackages
methods.description: Extracts the class name from a fully qualified name.

methods.name: stripDollars
methods.description: Removes trailing dollar signs and extracts the last part after the last dollar.

methods.name: getAllInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves all interfaces implemented by a class and its superclasses.
